_comment: EXAMPLE shop-level rate config — illustrative, industry-typical values only. Put your real shop rates in quote_params.local.json (gitignored) so they stay off public GitHub. Per-material rates live in app/materials.py.

cycle_time_estimation._comment: GVPP estimates cycle time from CAD geometry (TLK derives it from the operation graph instead). These knobs are intentionally conservative; the resulting time is flagged 'estimated_from_geometry'.
